title: Need-before-selection and objective HCP selection
description: Document legitimate need and selection criteria before selecting a specific HCP; criteria should relate to the service purpose rather than sales/prescribing metrics.
expected_evidence: need memo; selection criteria; approval record

title: FMV assessment for HCP services
description: Assess and document reasonable compensation using service type, expertise, preparation/delivery time and benchmark method; document justified deviations.

title: Verify actual HCP service performance
description: Maintain evidence that the contracted scientific/educational/consulting service actually occurred and matched scope.
expected_evidence: agenda; attendance; deliverable; presentation; acceptance record

title: HCP decision-role/conflict check
description: Identify prescribing, formulary, guideline, procurement and acceptance roles and apply enhanced review where the recipient can influence a company-relevant decision.
expected_evidence: role check; conflict questionnaire; enhanced approval

title: Reasonable-event travel control
description: Tie travel to actual event/service; limit luxury/leisure/companion costs; require reasonable class/hotel and documented itinerary.

title: Technical consultation boundary for public procurement
description: Permit objective product information while prohibiting creation of sham competitor quotes or manipulation of specification to predetermine result; escalate unusual customer requests.
expected_evidence: written customer request; technical materials; legal/compliance approval where needed

title: Distributor public-procurement red-flag review
description: For distributor tenders, review what manufacturer knows, requests, funds and approves; investigate unusual commissions, cash, competitor quotes, restrictive specs or requests involving customer officials.
expected_evidence: due diligence; tender support record; pricing rationale; escalation log

title: Commercially sensitive information provenance check
description: Record information owner, source, lawful reason for possession, sensitivity, recipients and intended use before acting on competitor/distributor data.
expected_evidence: source record; access justification; legal review

title: Risky request response and preservation
description: Do not execute a suspicious request; provide lawful alternative, preserve the request and escalate to Legal/Compliance. Never delete or fabricate records.
expected_evidence: original message; compliant response; escalation record

title: Identify payee, intermediary and ultimate beneficiary
description: For sponsorships/grants/event payments identify who is paid, who intermediates and who actually benefits; document relationship and purpose.

title: Mandatory Company Compliance Knowledge check
description: When company profile is active, query local rules for prohibition, permission, conditions, approvals, thresholds, exceptions, documentation and escalation; report coverage limitations.
expected_evidence: retrieval log; manifest status; cited card

title: Anti-corruption standards, procedures and document integrity
description: Maintain responsible function, standards/procedures, conflict controls and safeguards against unofficial/fake documentation consistent with organizational anti-corruption duties.
expected_evidence: policy; role designation; training; approval workflow; monitoring; remediation
